headlines.title: EU Electric Vehicle Sales Hit Record as Fuel Prices Surge
headlines.summary: Record-high fuel prices and a record number of newly available affordable models have pushed electric vehicle sales in the European Union to an all-time high this year, Transport & Environment, a European advocacy group for clean transport and energy, said in a report on Monday.
